links.outcome: Dentists' AI knowledge, training gaps, and association of learning methods with knowledge
links.effect: 50.3% familiar with AI; 16.3% actively used it; barriers: limited knowledge 69.9%, lack of training 73%. Multiple learning methods vs self-learning alone: OR 3.72 (95% CI 1.58–8.88).
links.quote: This study identified several key barriers: limited knowledge (69.9%), lack of training opportunities (73%), and financial limitations (69.4%).

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of Egyptian dentists assessing knowledge, attitudes, adoption, and barriers regarding AI in oral radiology.
